Container.Name: IPTVBoss
Container.Overview: IPTVBoss is an IPTV playlist and EPG management application. This Unraid template uses the upstream groenator IPTVBoss Docker image and opens the full noVNC browser client so copy and paste work from the browser window. The browser WebUI uses port 6901. XC Server uses port 8001. Native VNC on port 5901 is included as an optional fallback.

Config.Name: Browser WebUI Port
Config.Description: Browser noVNC WebUI port. The template opens the full noVNC client at /vnc.html so copy and paste work from the browser.

Config.Name: Native VNC Port
Config.Description: Optional native VNC port. Browser WebUI is recommended, but this can be used as a fallback with a VNC client.

Config.Name: XC Server Port
Config.Description: XC Server port. Only used when XC_SERVER is set to true.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent IPTVBoss app data. This path is required. Use a cache/appdata path if preferred.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file ownership. 99 is the default Unraid nobody user.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file ownership. 100 is the default Unraid users group.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Container timezone. Change this to your timezone.

Config.Name: VNC_PW
Config.Description: Browser noVNC password. If you change this value, update the WebUI URL password or enter the password manually at the noVNC login screen.

Config.Name: CRON_SCHEDULE
Config.Description: Cron schedule for automated IPTVBoss no-GUI runs. Default runs daily at 3 AM and 3 PM.

Config.Name: XC_SERVER
Config.Description: Enable IPTVBoss XC Server on port 8001.

Config.Name: CRONITOR_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional Cronitor API key. Leave blank if not using Cronitor.
